voice: Correct two spelling errors and assign Carrington's interrupted line to Carrington rather than the narrator.

entries.text: There's a wonderful piece of archaeological history. It grieves me to imagine it in some unaesthetic Philistine's unwashed hands.
I try to avoid people's personal affairs, Miss Bow. I find them infinitely distasteful.
...Miss Bow, I'm certain there is something I should be doing. I've enjoyed our chat, but please excuse me.
